Italy Upper-Secondary Repetition and Bocciatura Pressure¶

This notebook analyzes official ISTAT data on repeating students (ripetenti) in Italian upper-secondary education and uses it as the best currently available official proxy for bocciatura pressure in the 2024/2025 school-year window.

Focus of the analysis:

  • national differences between licei, istituti tecnici, and istituti professionali
  • trend evolution from 2015 to 2024
  • gender and course-year structure of repeaters
  • regional and local hotspots
  • tripartite inequality across territories

Methodological Scope¶

Source used here:

  • ISTAT SDMX flow 52_1044_DF_DCIS_SCUOLE_15 (Secondaria II grado - ripetenti per anno di corso)

Important limitation:

  • This is not a direct promossi/bocciati administrative dataset.
  • It is an official updated dataset on ripetenti, which is the strongest currently available official proxy for school failure pressure in the upper-secondary system.
  • The checked ISTAT upper-secondary indicator flow does not expose a direct promossi/bocciati variable, and the MIM SNV outcome files currently online are much older.

Interpretation rule used in this notebook:

  • TIME_PERIOD = 2024 is interpreted as proxy year 2024/2025.
In [1]:
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns

sns.set_theme(style='whitegrid', context='talk')
pd.set_option('display.max_columns', 50)
pd.set_option('display.width', 140)

ROOT = Path.cwd()
if ROOT.name == 'Notebooks':
    ROOT = ROOT.parent

LONG_PATH = ROOT / 'local_data' / 'ISTAT' / 'school_outcomes' / 'istat_repeaters_upper_secondary_long.csv'
LATEST_PATH = ROOT / 'local_data' / 'processed' / 'istat_repeaters_upper_secondary_latest.csv'
RANKING_PATH = ROOT / 'local_data' / 'processed' / 'istat_repeaters_upper_secondary_ranking.csv'
MANIFEST_PATH = ROOT / 'local_data' / 'processed' / 'istat_school_outcomes_sources_manifest.csv'

repeaters = pd.read_csv(LONG_PATH)
latest = pd.read_csv(LATEST_PATH)
ranking = pd.read_csv(RANKING_PATH)
manifest = pd.read_csv(MANIFEST_PATH)

repeaters['TIME_PERIOD'] = pd.to_numeric(repeaters['TIME_PERIOD'], errors='coerce')
repeaters['OBS_VALUE'] = pd.to_numeric(repeaters['OBS_VALUE'], errors='coerce')
latest['TIME_PERIOD'] = pd.to_numeric(latest['TIME_PERIOD'], errors='coerce')
latest['repeaters'] = pd.to_numeric(latest['repeaters'], errors='coerce')
ranking['TIME_PERIOD'] = pd.to_numeric(ranking['TIME_PERIOD'], errors='coerce')
ranking['repeaters'] = pd.to_numeric(ranking['repeaters'], errors='coerce')

TYPE_LABELS = {
    'ALL': 'All upper secondary',
    'LIC': 'Licei',
    'TEC': 'Technical institutes',
    'VOC': 'Vocational institutes'
}
SEX_LABELS = {'F': 'Girls', 'M': 'Boys', 'T': 'Total'}
COURSE_YEAR_LABELS = {
    'ALL': 'All years',
    'FIR': 'First year',
    'SEC': 'Second year',
    'THIR': 'Third year and later'
}

def classify_territory_level(code):
    code = str(code)
    if code == 'IT':
        return 'national'
    if len(code) == 3:
        return 'macroarea'
    if len(code) == 4:
        return 'region'
    if len(code) == 5:
        return 'province_like'
    return 'other'

repeaters['type_label'] = repeaters['TYPE_SCHOOL'].map(TYPE_LABELS).fillna(repeaters['TYPE_SCHOOL'])
repeaters['sex_label'] = repeaters['SEX'].map(SEX_LABELS).fillna(repeaters['SEX'])
repeaters['course_year_label'] = repeaters['SCHOOL_YEAR'].map(COURSE_YEAR_LABELS).fillna(repeaters['SCHOOL_YEAR'])
repeaters['territory_level'] = repeaters['REF_AREA'].map(classify_territory_level)

latest_year = int(repeaters['TIME_PERIOD'].max())
latest_proxy = repeaters.loc[repeaters['TIME_PERIOD'] == latest_year, 'SCHOOL_YEAR_PROXY'].dropna().iloc[0]

print('Rows loaded:', len(repeaters))
print('Latest period:', latest_year, '=>', latest_proxy)

Rows loaded: 54740
Latest period: 2024 => 2024/2025

Prepare the Main Analysis Views¶

To keep the comparisons interpretable, most charts below use total sex, total citizenship, all management types together, and all course years together.

In [3]:
base = repeaters[
    (repeaters['SEX'] == 'T')
    & (repeaters['CITIZENSHIP'] == 'TOTAL')
    & (repeaters['TYPE_SCHOOL_MANAGEMENT'] == 'ALL')
].copy()

national_by_type = base[(base['REF_AREA'] == 'IT') & (base['SCHOOL_YEAR'] == 'ALL')].copy()
latest_national_by_type = national_by_type[national_by_type['TIME_PERIOD'] == latest_year].copy()
latest_national_by_type = latest_national_by_type[['TYPE_SCHOOL', 'type_label', 'OBS_VALUE', 'TIME_PERIOD', 'SCHOOL_YEAR_PROXY']]
latest_national_by_type = latest_national_by_type.sort_values('OBS_VALUE', ascending=False)

regional_latest = base[
    (base['TIME_PERIOD'] == latest_year)
    & (base['SCHOOL_YEAR'] == 'ALL')
    & (base['TYPE_SCHOOL'] == 'ALL')
    & (base['territory_level'] == 'region')
].copy()

territorial_latest_by_type = base[
    (base['TIME_PERIOD'] == latest_year)
    & (base['SCHOOL_YEAR'] == 'ALL')
    & (base['TYPE_SCHOOL'] != 'ALL')
    & (base['territory_level'].isin(['region', 'province_like']))
].copy()

1. National Trend by School Type¶

The long-run trend shows how the tripartite system evolved over time. The 2021 break should be interpreted carefully because pandemic-era evaluation rules affected repetition.

In [4]:
trend = national_by_type[national_by_type['TYPE_SCHOOL'] != 'ALL'].copy()
fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(12, 6))
sns.lineplot(data=trend, x='TIME_PERIOD', y='OBS_VALUE', hue='type_label', marker='o', linewidth=2.5, ax=ax)
ax.set_title('Italy repeater rates by upper-secondary school type (2015-2024)', fontweight='bold')
ax.set_xlabel('Calendar year used as school-year proxy')
ax.set_ylabel('Repeaters rate')
ax.legend(title='School type')
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()

6. Tripartite Inequality Across Regions¶

The heatmap below compares regional repeater pressure separately for licei, tecnici, and professionali. The final table quantifies the gap between vocational and liceo repetition pressure.

In [10]:
regional_type_matrix = territorial_latest_by_type[territorial_latest_by_type['territory_level'] == 'region'].copy()
regional_type_matrix = regional_type_matrix.pivot_table(index='REF_AREA_LABEL', columns='type_label', values='OBS_VALUE')
regional_type_matrix = regional_type_matrix.sort_values('Vocational institutes', ascending=False)

7. Automated Findings¶

The final cell computes the main conclusions directly from the current data refresh.

In [11]:
latest_tracks = latest_national_by_type[latest_national_by_type['TYPE_SCHOOL'] != 'ALL'].copy()
highest_track = latest_tracks.sort_values('OBS_VALUE', ascending=False).iloc[0]
lowest_track = latest_tracks.sort_values('OBS_VALUE', ascending=True).iloc[0]
ratio = highest_track['OBS_VALUE'] / lowest_track['OBS_VALUE']

trend_prev = national_by_type[(national_by_type['TIME_PERIOD'] == latest_year - 1) & (national_by_type['TYPE_SCHOOL'] != 'ALL')][['TYPE_SCHOOL', 'OBS_VALUE']].rename(columns={'OBS_VALUE': 'prev'})
trend_curr = latest_tracks[['TYPE_SCHOOL', 'type_label', 'OBS_VALUE']].rename(columns={'OBS_VALUE': 'curr'})
changes = trend_curr.merge(trend_prev, on='TYPE_SCHOOL', how='left')
changes['change'] = changes['curr'] - changes['prev']

top_region = regional_chart.iloc[0]
bottom_region = regional_chart.iloc[-1]
top_vocational = top_by_type[top_by_type['TYPE_SCHOOL'] == 'VOC'][['REF_AREA_LABEL', 'OBS_VALUE']].head(5).copy()

highest_label = highest_track['type_label']
highest_value = float(highest_track['OBS_VALUE'])
lowest_label = lowest_track['type_label']
lowest_value = float(lowest_track['OBS_VALUE'])
top_region_name = top_region['REF_AREA_LABEL']
top_region_value = float(top_region['OBS_VALUE'])
bottom_region_name = bottom_region['REF_AREA_LABEL']
bottom_region_value = float(bottom_region['OBS_VALUE'])

print(f'Latest proxy year: {latest_proxy}')
print()
print('Key findings')
print(f'- Highest national repeater pressure: {highest_label} ({highest_value:.1f})')
print(f'- Lowest national repeater pressure: {lowest_label} ({lowest_value:.1f})')
print(f'- Highest/lowest track ratio: {ratio:.2f}x')
print(f'- Highest regional overall rate: {top_region_name} ({top_region_value:.1f})')
print(f'- Lowest regional overall rate: {bottom_region_name} ({bottom_region_value:.1f})')
print()
print('Year-on-year movement by school type')
for row in changes.sort_values('curr', ascending=False).itertuples():
    direction = 'down' if row.change < 0 else 'up'
    print(f'- {row.type_label}: {row.curr:.1f} ({direction} {abs(row.change):.1f} vs previous year)')
print()
print('Top vocational hotspots')
print(top_vocational.rename(columns={'OBS_VALUE': 'repeaters_rate'}).to_string(index=False))

Substantive Reading of the Situation¶

If the latest pattern remains stable after future updates, the main substantive interpretation is the following:

  • The tripartite system is not only differentiated by orientation, but also by very unequal exposure to repetition pressure.
  • Professionali appear to be the most fragile segment, followed by tecnici, while licei remain structurally more protected.
  • The geography of repeaters is not uniform: some southern and island territories are strong hotspots, but the pattern is not reducible to a simple North-South divide because some central and northern provinces also show elevated values.
  • A large vocational minus licei gap is a strong warning sign of segmented school trajectories inside the same regional system.
